claims.quote: Treatment of osteosarcoma is a combination of chemotherapy and surgery.
Neoadjuvant chemotherapy begins before surgical resection.

claims.text: adjuvant chemo ↑ 5-y survival from < 20% to > 65% in localized disease.
claims.quote: Use of adjuvant chemotherapy increases survival from < 20% to > 65% at 5 years for patients presenting with localized disease
